csv_project_name: Developer for Bayside Parks Access Project
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Sausalito invites qualified firms ( Proposers ) to submit proposals for the development of a Bayside Parks Access Project as described within this RFP. The selected consultant will need a City of Sausalito Encroachment Permit to perform fieldwork, if required, for any data collection, such as a topographic survey or any work necessitating traffic control.ADA Upgrades Evaluation of existing circulation routes, site constraints, and safety considerations at Yee Tock Chee Park, with recommendations and conceptual design solutions to improve accessibility in compliance with ADA requirements. Water Access Assessment of the Bayfront area between the Sausalito Yacht Club and The Spinnaker Restaurant to identify and develop multiple feasible options for safe, functional, and context-sensitive public water access
